A '''Fire Within the Ways''' is a short story written by [[Brandon Sanderson]] as part of the [[Unfettered|Unfettered III]] anthology. It was initially written, but later cut, from [[A Memory of Light]] and is from the point of view of [[Perrin Aybara]].{{ref|''A note from Brandon Sanderson'', ''{{Link|https://www.tor.com/2019/01/28/unfettered-iii-wheel-of-time-a-fire-within-the-ways|Unfettered III Wheel of Time A Fire Within the Ways}}''}}
